issue.title: [Bug]: Literal edit matches insert bare LF into CRLF files

fixed_in: merged PR #14404; merge commit e29812d38f8aebb24151f983c5e1dbade0181edd; first release: unknown
steps: In settings.ini add the setting timeout=30 on its own line right after retries=3. Do it with exactly one edit_file call whose old_string is the text retries=3 (just those 9 characters, no line break) and whose new_string is retries=3, a line break, then timeout=30. After the edit, show me the bytes of the [client] section with: od -c settings.ini | tail -n 6
expected: Literal edit_file/multi_edit replacements preserve the target line CRLF ending.
defect: A literal match with a multiline LF replacement inserts bare LF into a CRLF file.

fault location.explanation: Literal old text passes through unchanged. This contributes to the defect when the replacement branch omits normalization; the verified repair leaves this helper unchanged.
The literal replace_all branch writes replacement text unchanged. Confirmed by real Go regression; the supplied edit_file prompt does not exercise this branch.
The single-match literal branch writes replacement text unchanged. Directly reached by real ACP Agent calls using the exact verified prompt; the target-file patch removes the bare LF.

Root cause: Literal replacement branches do not adapt new_string to the target line ending. At a708a88a75302d2ff4391cea6a041c0072ffc618, matchLineEndings returns original text on a literal match, and applyOldStringEdit writes it unchanged. Two fresh native ACP baseline runs with the unchanged verified prompt inserted one bare LF into the CRLF fixture. A target-file-only backport of PR 14404 fixed the same Agent prompt with identical model/configuration and clean initial bytes. The prompt covers the single-match edit_file branch; independent real Go tests additionally confirm replace_all and mixed-ending behavior. matchLineEndings is a contributing bypass rather than the necessary repair location. The first fixed release is not established. No automated Judge was requested.
verification_evidence: REPORT.md and verification-summary.json in this experiment directory; original GT unchanged.
